reason: Alert 1 (xss) is a true positive. User input flows from request.getParameter() to param, then to bar. The ternary condition (7 * 42) - 106 > 200 evaluates to 188 > 200 (false), ensuring bar is assigned the user-controlled param value. Bar is written unsanitized to the HTTP response via response.getWriter(), creating a confirmed XSS vector.
